_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Contractor Integrated Technical Information System Implementation Plan (CITIS-IP)
summary: Describes how the CITIS will implement an Integrated Product and Process Development approach and Integrated Data Environment throughout the contract to satisfy service, infrastructure, media, and format requirements.
use_relationship:
The CITIS-IP describes the way in which the CITIS will implement an Integrated Product and Process Development (IPPD) and an Integrated Data Environment (IDE) throughout the life of the contract to satisfy service, infrastructure, media, and format requirements identified in the contract.

a. The CITIS-IP implements an ongoing forum to communicate the contractor's ability to integrate and provide the digital data services and products throughout the life of the contract.

b. This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task required as delineated in the contract.

c. The CITIS-IP serves as a record for the contractor's CITIS implementation activities at a fixed date in the life of the contract. Periodic Government and contractor reviews of the CITIS-IP over the life of the contract are necessary to determine if an update is required to incorporate current changes in computer technology, process improvements, or CITIS infrastructure requirements.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The CITIS-IP format shall be contractor selected. Unless effective presentation would be degraded, the initially used format shall be used for all subsequent submissions.

children.title: Pagination
children.content: Each page shall be uniquely numbered.

children.title: Document Control Numbers
children.content: All pages shall contain the document control number and date of the document.

children.title: Paragraph Numbering
children.content: Sections and paragraphs shall be numbered.

children.title: General CITIS-IP Structuring
children.content: General information that aids in understanding the CITIS-IP (e.g., background information, glossary, acronyms, abbreviations, and their meanings as used in the CITIS-IP) shall be located in a Notes section. Information pertinent to multiple topic areas (e.g., methodology description) shall be identified in appendices and provided with a cross-reference in the text to the Appendix.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The CITIS-IP shall contain detailed information of how the CITIS strategy is to be implemented. The plan shall include the following:

children.title: Introduction of the plan's purpose and scope
Reference documents, definitions, and points of contact
Description of the CITIS implementation
children.content: to include CITIS objectives, strategy, quality assurance, contents, test procedure, development and subsequent update timeline; contractor's responsibilities; Government responsibilities; and Government Concept of Operations (GCO) summary.

children.title: Listing of the CITIS hardware and software architecture to be used
children.content: description of the CITIS system, including source and destination systems, and relationships with Government receiving systems.

children.title: Description of proposed CITIS on-line capabilities
children.content:
The description shall include:

Linkages among engineering, manufacturing, logistics, and program management

Number and location of sites to be served, hours of operation, and system response requirements

Telecommunication issues including selection of Government data network(s) or third party leases of communication facilities, and the period of performance that includes each service location as the requirement varies

children.title: Description of telecommunication's data protection and integrity
children.content: including risk assessment and system security certification.

children.title: Outline of the proposed actions and upgrade capabilities
children.content: that may be pursued in subsequent life-cycle phases.
